title: observability: enhance token-level KV metrics, logging, dashboards & alert tuning
author: Ava Martinez
commits_summary: 3 commits: 1) initial dashboard and metric collection scaffolding; 2) add KV cache token-level cost/latency metrics + tracing context propagation; 3) alert tuning, docs and test fixes
description: Motivation: We currently lack fine-grained KV cache observability that ties token-level cost/latency with tracing and logs. This makes diagnosing regressions in Dedicated and Private deployments slow and increases SRE toil during incidents. This PR introduces token-level KV metrics, integrates tracing context into KV paths, updates dashboards for cost/latency breakdowns, and tunes alert thresholds to reduce noise. Changes: - Add new metric collection code (telemetry/metrics/token_kv_metrics.go) that emits: kv_cache_hit_tokens, kv_cache_miss_tokens, kv_token_latency_ms, kv_token_cost_microcostunits and associated labels (model, region, tenant_id, route) - Wire tracing context through KV codepath so token-level spans include model and cache decision (tracing/instrumentation/middleware.go) - New Grafana dashboard JSON (observability/dashboards/token_kv_cost_latency_dashboard.json) with panels for token-level cost/latency, KV hit heatmap, and per-route cost breakdown. Dashboard includes drilldowns to traces and logs. - Alert rule adjustments (infra/monitors/alert_rules.yml): lower latency SLO alert to 95th percentile token latency per-route, add a noise reduction window, and add an aggregated cost growth alert that groups by tenant tier. - Add tests and CI check (telemetry/metrics/token_kv_metrics_test.go, scripts/ci/instrumentation-check.sh) - Docs: observability/alerts.md and logging/kv_logging/README.md describe new metrics, recommended runbooks, and query examples Migration and rollout: feature gate token_kv_observability is off by default; rollout plan: opt-in for internal dev orgs, Canary in Dedicated for 48h, then org-wide enable behind feature flag. Backwards compatibility: metric names are additive; no breaking changes expected. Checklist: - [x] Unit tests for metric emission - [x] Integration smoke test in staging - [x] Dashboard reviewed by SRE - [x] Alert thresholds validated with historical data - [x] Docs updated Testing and CI: Initial CI run failed flakily on an integration that asserts trace context propagation; fixed by ensuring span context attach/detach in middleware. Final CI: all checks passed (lint, unit, integration-nightly rerun). Related: ENG-4821 (obs telemetry), ENG-4950 (kv cache optimization), SUP-1283 (customer-reported increased token costs).
review_comments:
Liam O'Connor (review): Overall looks good. Two requests: 1) Can we add tenant-tier label to the kv_token_cost metric for cheaper aggregation? 2) The 95th percentile alert window seems tight for cold-start-heavy routes
d suggest a 10m burn-in before firing.
Author (Ava): Added tenant_tier label and updated alert_rules.yml to include a 10m noise suppression window. See second commit.
Priya Patel (review): Please ensure metrics use stable names (no short-lived tags). Also nit: prefer explicit histogram buckets for kv_token_latency_ms instead of relying on defaults.
Author (Ava): Switched kv_token_latency_ms to an explicit histogram with predefined buckets tuned from historical latency distribution.
Diego Ramirez (approval): Verified dashboard panels in staging. Alerts behaved as expected during synthetic load test. Approving.
SRE (comment): When enabling org-wide, consider a phased enablement and a rollback plan tied to cost-growth alert. Added runbook note to docs.
release_notes: Add token-level KV observability: metrics (kv_cache_hit_tokens, kv_cache_miss_tokens, kv_token_latency_ms, kv_token_cost_microcostunits), tracing propagation for KV paths, new Grafana dashboard, and tuned alert rules to reduce noise. Feature gated behind token_kv_observability.
